correctness.rationale: The proof is correct. The extraspecial commutator descends to a nondegenerate alternating form on a \(2n\)-dimensional quotient. Lifts of a symplectic basis form a dominating set whose paired basis edges also give total and paired domination. For an arbitrary dominating set with proper span \(W\), every nonzero quotient vector in \(W^\perp\) has all \(p\) of its lifts commuting with the selected set and therefore must itself be selected. Those forced vertices span \(W^\perp\); adding the remaining span dimension and using \(p(p^m-1)\ge 2m\) gives the lower bound \(2n\). The argument covers characteristic two and all extraspecial types.
